summary: Full re-test of Dobryi Energy site after UI restructure (sunshinepower.fr-inspired centered storytelling + hamburger menu). Backend: 7/7 pytest pass, exactly 1 real devis email sent (respecting the 1-email cap for this run). Frontend: 66/66 data-testid + flow checks pass across Home (hero + CTAs, stats counters, manifesto, solutions/markets, expertise 5 cards, trust-bar with 5 chips, final-cta with devis+whatsapp), Header (floating logo, top-center devis pill, hamburger toggle, mobile-menu overlay with nav-solutions/realisations/a-propos/contact), Solutions (5 cards + CTAs), Realisations (hero, filter-Tous, 6 cards, filter-Agricole reduces to 2), About (hero, valeurs with 3 cards, about-cta), Contact (hero, form, sector+project pills, success screen), FloatingActions (toggle + WhatsApp/phone with correct hrefs), Footer (email dobryienergy@gmail.com + phone 07 73 67 42 57). Contact form submission validated via mocked /api/devis route to avoid a second real email.

issues: The success paragraph 'Votre demande a bien été envoyée. Nous vous recontactons sous 24h ouvrées.' is rendered in text-muted2 (very low luminance) against the near-black card background, so it becomes nearly invisible after submission. Consider bumping to text-casse or increasing contrast (WCAG AA).

action_items: OPTIONAL/design: Increase contrast of the confirmation paragraph inside data-testid='contact-success' — currently uses text-muted2 which is barely readable on dark background.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py remains clean (<250 lines), async Mongo, UUID id (no ObjectId leak), Pydantic + EmailStr validation returning 422 on invalid input, safe HTML escape in email template. Good.
Header restructure: nav links correctly gated behind hamburger; menu overlay uses data-testid='mobile-menu' and each link has data-testid='nav-<slug>'. Selectors match the spec exactly.

Home.jsx uses all requested data-testids (hero, hero-cta-devis, hero-cta-solutions, stats-section, manifesto, solutions-section, market-cta-*, expertise-section, solution-card-*, trust-bar, final-cta, final-cta-devis, final-cta-whatsapp). No gaps observed.

About.jsx: previously reported testid deviations (about-valeurs, about-cta) are now aligned; about-chiffres section is intentionally removed in this restructure (no chiffres section exists on the new About page), so no follow-up needed unless product wants it back.
Realisations: filter for a specific sector (e.g. Agricole) correctly reduces cards from 6 to 2. Good state handling.
Contact form: correct axios POST to `${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api/devis`, error + loading + success states all handled with disabled submit and toast. Sonner Toaster mounted locally. Good.
Minor: EchoHeading stacks the echo three times with negative margins (-0.9em) — visually striking but the 3rd faded echo can overlap final-cta content on very small viewports. Not a functional bug.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: 1 TEST_-prefixed devis record was created in Mongo `devis` collection during backend tests (respecting the 1-email cap). UUID-tagged (TEST_User_<hex>), safe to prune.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py now sends exactly 1 real devis email (the persistence-duplicate POST was replaced with a min_length validation test to respect the 1-email cap). Frontend contact form test uses page.route to mock /api/devis and validate the success screen without triggering an additional email. If re-running full suite, one more email will be sent per run. Nav links live inside the hamburger overlay — always click data-testid='header-menu-toggle' first, then data-testid='nav-<slug>'. Animations settle within ~2.5s of navigation.
